notes:
• Notes write like Obsidian: one view, formatting appears as you type
• Notes live as files in a Notes folder: New note on top, a grid view, colours tint the whole note
• A new timeline strip: every scene by its real length over a page ruler, with total pages and minutes
• Right-click menus are real Mac menus (colours stay one row of dots)
• Fixed: dropping a picture on a character page no longer takes over the app
• Relationships: pick someone in a character's document — a Relationship card appears on the map, and both documents list it; edit it on either side
• Clicking a character on the map takes its ring of cards along; cards sit evenly round it
• Acts resize smoothly with their beats, and a single act stays where you drop it
• Beats sent to the script: you start writing right under the first one
• A zoom slider for the page, board or note you're in (⌘ + / − on the number pad too)
• Script header: Title page with Write / Page / Cards, element menu in the middle, one click (⌥⌘0) for the page alone
• A cleaner welcome window: New Project and Open… on the left, your recent projects on the right
• Calmer sliders and switches, no music glow; play doesn't wake ambience you switched off
